title: Is there an app that teaches AI skills as short podcast episodes?
metaTitle: An app that teaches AI as short podcast episodes
lede: Yes. Iro can play any of its AI lessons as a two-to-three-minute podcast episode, then has you practise what you heard. Here's how it works and who it suits.
keyTakeaways: Iro plays any lesson as a 2 to 3 minute podcast episode, with two hosts, Sam and Ava, talking it through.
Each episode sits next to a five-minute hands-on lesson, so you listen first and then practise.
Lesson podcasts are part of Iro Pro; the lessons themselves are free to start, on iPhone and the web.

description: Yes: Iro turns any AI lesson into a 2 to 3 minute podcast episode with two hosts, then has you practise it. On iPhone and the web. How it works and what it costs.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.html:
Yes. Iro is an app on iPhone and the web that can play any of its AI lessons as a short podcast episode, about two to three minutes long. Two hosts, Sam and Ava, talk the lesson through, then you do the five-minute hands-on version and get instant feedback on what you tried.

That pairing is the point. You can listen on a walk or a commute, then practise when you have your hands free.

sections.heading: How the episodes work
sections.html:
• Length: two to three minutes per episode, one episode per lesson.
  • Format: two hosts, Sam and Ava, in a conversation rather than a lecture.
  • Then practice: each lesson ends in an exercise, like writing a real prompt, spotting the false claim in an AI answer or choosing the right tool, with feedback straight away.
  • Where: in the Iro app on iPhone and on the web.

sections.heading: What you can listen to
sections.html: Iro has 34 learning paths and 522 lessons, and any lesson can be an episode. Paths include tool courses for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Perplexity and Cursor, a 30-lesson prompt engineering path, a 33-lesson AI Foundations path for complete beginners, and role paths for marketing, managers, finance and more.

sections.heading: Why listening is not enough
sections.html:
A good AI podcast keeps you up to date, but hearing someone describe a prompt doesn't teach you to write one. The skill shows up when you try it on a real task and see what comes back.

So use the episode as the warm-up and the exercise as the workout. Two to three minutes of listening plus five minutes of practice a day adds up quickly.

sections.heading: What it costs
sections.html: Lesson podcasts are part of Iro Pro, which is $49.99 a year or $9.99 a month, with a 7-day trial. Without Pro, every one of the 34 paths is still open, paced by a Battery that gives you a full lesson a day and recharges overnight.
